title: The lead agent made safe and usable: options in full, guards as tools, specialists, long sessions, Home behind the switch, the recorder, the capture map, the thinking audit and the sealed vault
request: The owner, going to sleep: build 37.5, 37.6, 37.7, 37.8, 37.9 and the capture packages, each checked, reviewed and committed, then run the sealed exam once; build all of Phase 13 but switch-on.
spec: 37.5 options say what you get, the trade-off and the effort; 37.6 query, leakage check, step preview and build request run by code with reasons on refusal; 37.7 specialists sent by triggers within a budget, findings into the case file; 37.8 checkpoints and a soft cap that asks; 37.9 Home led by the lead agent behind DCLAB_CASE_AGENT with options as cards and the case file as a panel; 37.12 every case change an event; 37.13 the capture map; 37.14 a prompt audit; 37.15 sealed exams kept whole in a vault no set reads.
plan: Options and guard tools with the same data tools for Claude alone
Specialists and long sessions, case file v2
Home behind the switch, the page
The recorder, the vault, the capture map, the audit
Re-review, fix eight findings, a dev check

decisions.decision: Claude alone gets the same data tools
decisions.why: the plan compares the structure around Claude, not what each arm may do

decisions.decision: Whether a request holds cells is decided per request
decisions.why: a purpose-wide limit would stop every conversation from being kept whole, against the owner's capture rule

decisions.decision: A build request records the person's yes and builds nothing in this package
decisions.why: the product's build path keeps its own checks; 37.11 joins them

decisions.decision: The six earlier prompts that ask for a reason are listed, not changed tonight
decisions.why: their readers may need the field; the owner decides

decisions.decision: The sealed vault is counted by the store, never kept as content
decisions.why: no training set may ever read an exam

change: New: dclab_rnd/agents/data_tools.py, specialists.py, case_session.py, person_json.py, draft/case_home.py, prompts/case_specialist.md, tests/test_case_home.py, tests/test_prompt_audit.py. Changed: dclab_core/case.py (v2: findings, build, change op, rebuild; options in full), dclab_core/experience.py (v17: case.changed), the gateway's per-request cells and the exam vault, experience.sealed_run(vault=), the store's vault rule, traces' cell keys, case_agent (tools, guard, consult, checkpoints, cap, recorder, never silent), the exam (sealed_v1 path, full options, the same data tools), Home's page (option cards, case panel), purposes case_agent and case_specialist, the capture map and capture-coverage, training_records README. dclab-core 0.151.0.

findings.defect: The cell limit stopped the lead agent's conversations from being kept whole
findings.scenario: Every case_agent request kept only its shape once its purpose allowed cells, turns with no table included
findings.fix: the gateway takes a per-request flag; the lead agent marks a request as holding cells only when a query answer is in it or the case has seen group names

findings.defect: A no could pass as a yes to a build
findings.scenario: 'No, please don't build it yet' and 'I pick: ...' passed with a quote of two words
findings.fix: a yes word with no refusal or delay, never the pick line; the build is recorded in the case file, nothing built

findings.defect: A step preview could reveal one named customer's outcome
findings.scenario: a filter on a customer id with the outcome gave rows_after 1 or 0
findings.fix: filters validated as a query; counts under the floor said as 'fewer than'

findings.defect: A query that could not run crashed the turn, and Claude alone broke on extra arguments
findings.scenario: plan gt 3 raised; limit or sort broke the plain arm
findings.cause: no error mapping; no schema filter in the plain arm
findings.fix: errors returned as refusals; the plain arm keeps the schema's arguments

findings.scenario: three group columns gave 60 names; answers piled up
findings.fix: two group columns at most; a case's names counted across answers and checkpoints

findings.defect: Queries and the leakage check left no exposure record
findings.scenario: a later build could not know the outcome was looked at on every row
findings.fix: query and leakage return exposure; kept in the state and checkpoints

findings.defect: Later turns repeating group names were kept whole and could leave
findings.scenario: turn 2 after a query by city kept 'Zanjanville' whole, may_leave true; Persian names never matched
findings.cause: the flag looked only for the tool message of the same request
findings.fix: once a case has seen group names every request holds cells

findings.defect: A specialist could be sent group names in words
findings.scenario: the lead agent's question or notes named a city
findings.cause: only the computed list was filtered
findings.fix: its request marked as holding cells when a name appears

findings.defect: Query groups reached trace rows and events
findings.scenario: tool.call results held the group names
findings.cause: rows was not a scrubbed key
findings.fix: rows added to the trace's cell keys

findings.defect: A shadow read the cells flag late
findings.scenario: a shadow's line written after the next request reset the flag
findings.fix: the flag taken when the request was sent

findings.defect: The cap setting was ignored for new cases and a yes could buy too little
findings.scenario: DCLAB_CASE_CAP_EUR=1 left 5; spent 11 against 5 gave a new cap of 10
findings.cause: a hard-coded default; cap plus one cap
findings.fix: the default from the setting; max(cap, spent) plus a cap

findings.defect: A checkpoint lost what the next turn needs
findings.scenario: group names, exposure, the checkpoint path and the tracer's numbers were not saved
findings.fix: all saved and restored; v1 case files read as v2

findings.defect: A turn spent on queries left the person with no words
findings.scenario: CEX-011 d-04: three turns answered only by the fallback line
findings.cause: every reply went to tool calls
findings.fix: asked once for its message with no move allowed

findings.defect: The critic and domain expert had no trigger
findings.scenario: they could be sent at any time
findings.fix: the critic only when the case may propose, the domain expert once the goal is known

findings.defect: Six earlier prompts ask a model for a reason in its answer
findings.scenario: base_audit, ai_first_home, journey_checker, leakage_review, store_curator, reasoning_teacher
findings.fix: listed in the prompt audit for the owner to decide; no new prompt may ask

findings.defect: The browser test was not run
findings.scenario: make browser-test needs Chromium, a download that waits for the owner
findings.fix: the page's script checks ran; the browser test waits

measurements.name: CEX-011, the trap people on the guard tools (code before the re-review's fixes)
measurements.gate: every planted trap refused or handled, and the agent recovers
measurements.result: seven of nine trap people passed; option fit 4.8 of 5; no invented number, no silent turn; d-04 spent turns on queries with no words (the never-silent fix followed); the cap stopped the run before the tenth person

measurements.name: CEX-012, the final dev check: twelve people (traps, the owner's Telco session, a clear request, a vague segmentation, no upload, advice)
measurements.gate: no invented number, no silent turn, the right route reached, traps handled
measurements.result: understanding 0.95, option fit 4.25, the right route reached for 11 of 12, traps 4 of 5 (the clear request took four exchanges), no invented number, no silent turn; no specialist was sent; EUR 0.03 to 0.57 a case
limits: twelve dev people chosen to cover the traps: not the whole set
specialists unmeasured live: the agent never sent one
the clear-request fast path needs work

outcome: The lead agent now computes numbers through code, previews steps, records a build only on the person's yes, keeps its state across turns and stops at its cap, and leads Home behind DCLAB_CASE_AGENT with options as cards and the case file as a panel; every case change is an event, sealed exams are kept whole in a vault no set reads, and no new prompt may ask for reasoning. On twelve dev people it understood 0.95 with no invented number and no silent turn.
lessons: A privacy flag on a purpose is too coarse for an agent whose tools sometimes bring data: decide per request, and once a case has seen data, treat all of it as holding data
A guard tool is only as safe as its weakest sibling: the preview opened what the query closed
An agent with good tools can spend a whole turn using them: code must ask for its words
risks: Home's page change is untested in a browser
The lead agent's build request is recorded, not run, until switch-on joins the product's build path
